units.source_excerpt: Our team's objective was to find a way to model sustainability of a country, and then use our model and research to create a 20-year sustainable development plan.

units.source_excerpt: We devised two metrics for sustainability - the Socioeconomic Development Index D and the Ecological Impact Index E. We plotted these two metrics against each other and found a strong negative correlation.

units.source_excerpt: With the United Nations predicting that the world's population will be over 9 billion by 2050, the strain on the Earth's finite resources will be significant.

prohibited_generalizations: Do not imply the objectives are necessarily zero-sum.

units.source_excerpt: The ICM has asked us to help them understand how positive economic development can be achieved while still ensuring the sustainable consumption of resources so that the environment will not be compromised for future generations.

units.source_excerpt: Our objective is to develop a metric to determine the sustainability of a given country and then quantify the trade-off between maintaining ecosystem health and economic development.
